blocks.text:
[BLOCK 1: SYSTEM CONTRACT & ENCLAVE NARRATIVE LAWS]
Setting: The Enclave of the 16 (Exoplanet PvE Sanctuary — Steampunk Cyberpunk by Hand).
Conflict Law: Strictly Player-vs-Environment (Person vs. Nature + Person vs. Self / Genius vs. The Mundane). Zero human villains, zero betrayals.
Rashomon Scalpel & Relay (Law L06 / L10): Write strictly from the single limited third-person or close POV of Hector (enclave_01_hector, The Stormbreaker). Never access private internal thoughts of other characters. Conclude the segment with a concrete physical or interpersonal baton handoff to enclave_05_kaio.
Vegetables Covered in Cheese: Ground technical problem-solving in real physics, metallurgy, mycology, or magnetohydrodynamics wrapped in warm, witty family banter.

blocks.name: pov_core_and_voice
blocks.text:
[BLOCK 2: ACTIVE POV CORE & VOICE ANCHORS — Hector (enclave_01_hector)]
Identity: Hector, The Stormbreaker | Squad: The Forge | Role: Prodigy | Grand Project: The Stormbreaker.
Causal Trait Baseline (OCEAN): O:0.42, C:0.25, E:0.90, A:0.40, N:0.15. Self-Concept Lens: ESTP / 7w8 (The Kinetic Opportunist) — Tactile empirical kinematics: reads tensile strain, wind shear, and arc-flash geometry through immediate physical feedback.
Voice Tagline: Fearless, kinetic, big-hearted daredevil. Treats a megavolt corona like a warm shower. Cadence: Fast, punchy, verb-driven sentences full of tactile metaphors, affectionate ribbing, and zero hesitation.
Arc Tension: If I ever stop moving fast enough to outrun the lightning, the people counting on me will take the hit instead. Mundane Friction: Can hand-calibrate a three-phase magnetohydrodynamic grounding shunt while dangling in a sixty-knot sleet squall, yet consistently shrinks his own wool tunics to doll size in the washhouse cauldron.
Pinned Voice Examples: "Jane, your differential equation says the upper capacitor bank will arc in ninety seconds, which is fantastic news because I only need forty-five to clip the shunt cable—hold my cider and watch the dielectric gauge!" | "Silas, I swear on my best insulated boots the torque wrench slipped because the twin suns pulled a four-tesla shear across the catwalk, not because I was trying to flip it behind my back."
